description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for rendering content as text within the OFBiz framework. It handles content rendering, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

classes.name: RenderContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to render content as text, with support for editing links and XML escaping.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that renders content based on provided arguments, handling content retrieval, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, including handling locale, XML escaping, and error logging.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps the content in a div with a specified edit style.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the edit wrapper by adding an 'Edit' link pointing to the content editing interface.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS class for the edit wrapper, defaulting to 'buttontext' if not specified.
